app.title: {app} — books to Xteink (CrossPoint)
gui.by_author: Organize into author folders (like the organize-by-author plugin)
gui.optimize: Optimize EPUB before sending (protective CSS, no embedded fonts)
log.pandoc_missing: ✗ pandoc not found! Install it: brew install pandoc
log.calibre_missing: Calibre not found — mobi/azw3 will be skipped (optional: brew install --cask calibre); PDF works without it
log.pillow_found: Pillow: images in EPUB will be optimized (grayscale, ≤800×480, non-progressive JPEG)
log.hint_transfer: On the reader, enable File Transfer → Join Network, then click "Find" or go straight to "Convert and send".
log.hint_format: Click the "Format" column to change the send format: EPUB → XTC (B&W pages) → XTCH (grayscale pages). XTC/XTCH open without indexing; their font size is chosen in pt, as in the firmware.
log.searching: Searching for a device on the network…
log.not_found_gui: ✗ Device not found. Make sure the reader is in File Transfer → Join Network mode and on the same Wi-Fi network (2.4 GHz). You can enter the IP manually.
log.select_rows: Select rows in the list (Cmd+click), then apply the format.
log.device_error: ✗ Device error: {error}. Make sure the reader is in File Transfer mode and the address is correct.
log.device_other_ip: Device found at a different address: {ip}
log.device_no_answer: Device {host} is not responding (attempt {n}) — retrying in {interval} s…
log.reader_not_found: Reader not found (attempt {n}) — retrying in {interval} s… Enable File Transfer → Join Network and keep the QR screen open: Wi-Fi only works in this mode.
log.optimizing: Optimizing EPUB: protective CSS, removing embedded fonts{images}…
log.xtc_not_installed: ⚠ XTC converter not installed (run setup_xtc.command) — books will be sent as EPUB.
log.xtc_font: XTC conversion: font {pt}pt (≈{px}px on a 480×800 screen); bigger font — more pages and a bigger file
log.optimized: ⚙ {name}: {before}→{after} KB [fonts −{fonts}, CSS +{css}/−{css_clean} harmful, comments −{comments}, images {images}, repaired {repairs}]
log.prep_done: Preparation done: {n} file(s) ready to send. Connecting to the device…
log.patch_failed: ⚠ failed to apply the XTC pagination patch — font size may not take effect (converter updated)
log.xtc_converter_missing: ⚠ XTC converter not found — XTC format unavailable
dlg.need_pandoc: pandoc is required: brew install pandoc
err.pandoc_no_epub: pandoc did not produce an EPUB
err.calibre_only: only Calibre can convert {ext} (brew install --cask calibre)
err.calibre_no_epub: ebook-convert did not produce an EPUB
err.device_timeout: device did not appear within {timeout} s
err.pymupdf_needed: PyMuPDF is required for PDF (pip install pymupdf in .venv)
err.pandoc_needed_pdf: pandoc is required for PDF reflow (brew install pandoc)
err.ddjvu_needed: DjVu needs DjVuLibre (ddjvu): macOS — brew install djvulibre, Linux — sudo apt install djvulibre-bin, Windows — DjVuLibre from djvu.sourceforge.net
cli.description: BookSender: convert books to EPUB and send to Xteink/CrossPoint
cli.wait_timeout: how many seconds to wait for the device (0 = forever)
cli.flat: do not organize into author folders (all files directly in dest)
cli.no_optimize: do not optimize EPUB before sending
cli.format: send format for all books (xtc/xtch — no indexing on the device)
cli.font_pt: font size for XTC conversion in pt, as in the firmware (12/14/16/18; default 14)
cli.find: only find devices on the network
cli.tkinter_missing:
Tkinter is unavailable ({error}). Install Python with tkinter (python.org; on Linux: python3-tk package) and run: python book_sender.py
Or use the CLI: --cli --folder ... --host ...
